hypotheses.fixedByVideoFrameBoundaries: refuted: VBlankIntr contributes one ambient draw on each intervening frame, but the next construction burst begins at different frame offsets and the first/last epoch frames are phase-sensitive.
hypotheses.fixedByMonBoundaries: refuted: ambient draws occur after mon 0 and mon 1, and continue after the final mon before the function returns; the counts are not a constant mon-boundary insertion.

repeatableDrawOrWorkBudget.evidence: The same source path has attempt vectors [13,7,36] and [59,12,30] in the two three-mon cases, with different frame gaps [10,12] and [11,10]; species/stat work and interrupt phase matter in addition to draw count.

hypotheses.emulatorCycleTiming: supported: the smallest source-general explanation is the VBlank interrupt schedule sampled by a construction call whose CPU-cycle duration crosses frame boundaries; a TypeScript frame tick with source-state-only RNG cannot derive those crossings.

designVerdict.smallestGenericContract: Carry the construction epoch's RNG cursor plus an explicit deterministic construction clock: initial cycle/phase within the VBlank period, exact source-operation cycle budget (including species/stat work), and the VBlank ambient callback at each crossed period. This is source-general and avoids fixture-specific per-mon cursors; without that clock contract, personality-exact live generation is intentionally unsupported.
designVerdict.productionBoundary: Do not import this receipt or any per-fixture cursor schedule into production. The receipt is test-only evidence for the next MAIN implementation.
